0022600223.text: The Brooklyn Nets (2-8, 1-5 on the road, 13th in the East) take on the New Orleans Pelicans (4-7, 3-3 at home, 12th in the West) in their 11th game of the season, with Brooklyn on a two-game losing streak and New Orleans on three straight losses. The teams split their 2025-26 season series 1-1, and their most recent meeting was a 116-113 Brooklyn loss in New Orleans on January 14, 2026, while the 2026-27 series has no games played yet. Brooklyn is without Mikel Brown Jr. (out with illness; 12.9 points and 23.2 minutes per game this season) and Nolan Traore is day-to-day with calf soreness and a game-time decision, while New Orleans is missing Bennedict Mathurin (out, thumb sprain), Trendon Watford (out, ankle sprain), and Yves Missi (out, knee bruise), with Trey Murphy III day-to-day with knee tendinitis and a game-time decision.
